name: Vent Fab
old_description: We provide excellent service in specialty and custom fabrication from start to finish by meeting with our customer on site
about:
Vent Fab operates from Woodbury, Minnesota. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It began as a custom duct fabrication shop focused on serving HVAC contractors with on-site consultation and rapid turnaround.

The shop specializes in high-volume sheet metal fabrication, welding, and custom duct manufacturing. Its capabilities include spiral duct and fittings, coil line duct production using patented coil loading and auto corner insertion equipment, and certified TIG and MIG welding. The facility handles orders ranging from small change-outs to 10,000-pound duct runs.

Vent Fab serves the HVAC, commercial kitchen, medical facility, clean room, marine, and industrial process sectors. Its customers include mechanical contractors, field foremen, and project managers who rely on the company for duct revisions, tenant improvements, and full HVAC system installations.

The company positions itself as an extension of the customer's operation, emphasizing upfront specification verification, triple-check quality control, honored pricing, and on-time delivery to the exact job-site location.
